task: Fix pitch option and studio view switcher tab alignment, vertical sizing overflow, and contrast bleeding in CreateProjectPage
rootCause: TabsTrigger default py-2 padding in Tabs.jsx produced a 32px button that overflowed TabsList's 28px content box (h-9 with p-1) by 4px, bleeding over the top and bottom borders. The right TabsList was also styled with bg-card while the left pitch options used bg-muted/60, causing contrast inversion and vertical misalignment.

changes.summary: Updated TabsList to inline-flex items-center justify-center border border-border bg-muted/50 p-1, and TabsTrigger to inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-xs with bg-card active elevation.

Harmonized Pitch Option container and View Switcher Tabs: both now share h-9 container height, bg-muted/50 background, border border-border, p-1 padding, and h-7 button pills with bg-card active elevation.
Playwright audit script capturing DOM bounding rects and visual proof across dark mode.

verification.playwrightVisualAudit: Verified 4px padding symmetry without border bleeding (list height 36px, tab height 28px, exactly 4px top and bottom inset).
